verses.text: These are Solomon's proverbs. A wise son makes his dad glad, but a foolish son breaks his mom's heart.
Riches you got by doing wrong do you no good, but doing what's right saves you from death.
The LORD won't let people who do right go hungry, but he pushes away what the wicked crave.
Work with lazy hands and you'll end up poor. Diligent hands bring in wealth.
A wise son brings in the crop in summer. A son who sleeps through harvest brings shame.
Blessings rest on the heads of people who do right, but violence covers the mouths of the wicked.
People remember those who did right with a blessing, but the name of the wicked will rot.
Wise hearts take instruction. A fool who can't stop talking is headed for a fall.
Walk with integrity and you can walk secure. Take a crooked route and you'll get found out.
A sneaky wink can cause real hurt, and a fool who can't stop talking is headed for a fall.
What good people say is like a spring that gives life, but violence covers the mouths of the wicked.
Hatred gets fights going, but love covers every wrong.
Listen to somebody with good judgment and you'll hear wisdom. There's a rod for the back of somebody with no sense.
Wise people store up what they learn. A fool's mouth is always one step from disaster.
A rich person's money is like a fortified city. For poor people, poverty itself can bring them down.
The work of people who do right leads to life. What the wicked earn leads to sin.
Take correction and you're on the road to life. Brush it off and you'll lead others off course.
Hide your hate and you end up lying through your teeth. Spread slander and you're being a fool.
Keep piling on words and you're bound to say something wrong. A wise person knows when to stop talking.
The words of people who do right are like the finest silver. What's in the hearts of the wicked is worth little.
The words of people who do right feed many, but fools die because they lack sense.
The LORD's blessing is what makes people rich, and he doesn't pile trouble on top of it.
Doing wrong is fun to a fool. Wisdom is what makes a person with understanding happy.
What wicked people dread will catch up with them. What people who do right long for will be given to them.
When the whirlwind has blown through, the wicked are gone. People who do right stand firm forever.
Sending a lazy person on an errand is like getting vinegar on your teeth or smoke in your eyes.
Standing in awe of the LORD adds days to your life, but the wicked will have their years cut short.
The future brings joy for people who do right. The hopes of the wicked will come to nothing.
The LORD's way is a fortress to people who live honestly, but it brings ruin to people who do wrong.
People who do right will never be uprooted, but the wicked won't get to live in the land.
Wisdom comes from the mouths of people who do right. A tongue that twists things will be cut off.
People who do right know what words fit the moment. The wicked keep talking crooked.
